- (ttp-attack-mapping-reliability) src-0020's kappa=0.68 IS RESTRICTED TO A RANDOM 10% SAMPLE OF 195 SENTENCES AND IS MEASURED AT PHASE (ii) OF SIX, BEFORE RELABELLING AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION. THE STATE STORES NEITHER RESTRICTION. Opened by cycle 47's G2, the FIRST G2 ever run on src-0020 (added cycle 43, never re-checked). This is the THIRD instance of the omitted-clause shape (after ctr-0012 and ctr-0015) and it answers ctr-0015 step (iv) -- which asked precisely whether src-0020's per-technique kappas are themselves restricted -- in the affirmative. IT IS ALSO THE FIRST TIME THAT A REPAIR STEP LEFT 'NOT DONE AND OPTIONAL' BY A PREDECESSOR HAS BEEN DISCHARGED BY A SUCCESSOR AND FOUND A DEFECT. WHAT THE STATE SAYS. src-0020 key_claims[1] stores, verbatim and with exactly this ellipsis, 'Cohen's kappa was ~computed ... per technique to account for chance agreement~'. The stored fragment ends at 'chance agreement'. The same claim then characterises the statistic as 'a MEAN over 114 per-technique kappa values with no confidence interval', which is true as far as it goes and says nothing about WHICH ITEMS the values were computed over. ctr-0015 relied on that characterisation when it separated the three estimands, and described estimand (1) as 'the only one of the three measured over an unrestricted item set'. THAT CHARACTERISATION IS NOW FALSE AND ctr-0015's OWN WORDING MUST BE READ SUBJECT TO THIS ENTRY. WHAT THE SOURCE SAYS. A verification-mode fetch of https://arxiv.org/html/2606.18166v1 on 2026-08-01 returned the ENTIRE six-phase annotation paragraph verbatim, and a SECOND, SEPARATE exact-string ask on the literal strings 'on a random 10% sample (195 sentences)' and 'which was collected from both annotators' returned PRESENT for both with the same clause -- rule (xiii) complied with deliberately, because a summarised read may manufacture a defect. THE PARAGRAPH, VERBATIM AND WHOLE: 'We carried out the annotation in six phases: (i) Independent Labeling, where the annotators labeled the allocated reports independently; (ii) Initial Cross-Labeling, where we computed Cohen's Kappa (K) per technique to account for chance agreement on a random 10% sample (195 sentences), which was collected from both annotators; (iii) Relabeling, where the annotators re-evaluated 981 low-agreement sentences (K<0.7), split 460/521 between first and second annotators; (iv) Secondary Cross-Labeling, where we checked 10% of the data relabeled in step-iii (98 sentences) to verify K improvement; (v) Dispute Resolution, where we resolved conflicts via reconciliation meeting; and (vi) Dataset Aggregation, where we merged data of from all phases into the final ground-truth dataset.' (K written for the Greek kappa throughout, which is the only rendering difference from the source.) THE DEFECT, IN THREE LIMBS. LIMB 1 -- SAMPLE RESTRICTION AND PRECISION. The 114 per-technique kappa values are each estimated from a 195-sentence sample, not from the 2,076-sentence corpus. src-0020 itself reports '2,028 technique occurrences' over 2,076 sentences, so a 10% sample carries on the order of 200 technique occurrences to be spread across 114 techniques -- of the order of TWO positive instances per technique on average. A per-technique Cohen's kappa estimated from that many positives is extremely imprecise, and the paper reports the mean WITH NO CONFIDENCE INTERVAL. The derived per-technique occurrence figure in this sentence IS A CYCLE-47 DERIVATION from two printed numbers and is labelled as such under rule (xii); the printed numbers are exact. LIMB 2 -- WHICH PHASE THE VALUE DESCRIBES. The paper's headline sentence reads 'Following the six-phase process, we reached a mean inter-annotator agreement of K=0.68 across 114 techniques (Landis and Koch: substantial agreement), with 65 techniques (57.0%) exceeding the K>=0.7 quality threshold' -- confirmed PRESENT as one whole sentence by the same exact-string ask, so the base's stored quotation of it is accurate. But the paragraph places the kappa computation at phase (ii), Initial Cross-Labeling, with phases (iii) relabelling, (iv) a re-check 'to verify K improvement', and (v) dispute resolution all coming AFTER it. 'FOLLOWING THE SIX-PHASE PROCESS, WE REACHED' AND 'COMPUTED AT PHASE (ii) OF SIX' CANNOT BOTH BE READ STRICTLY. This is a tension INSIDE THE SOURCE, not a state defect, and it is recorded here rather than asserted as an error: the paper does not state anywhere read so far that kappa was recomputed after phase (iv), and the 0.68 may be either the initial agreement or a final one. NOBODY MAY RESOLVE THIS TENSION BY PICKING THE READING THAT SUITS THEM. LIMB 3 -- WHAT SURVIVES, STATED NARROWLY SO THIS ENTRY IS NOT OVER-READ. Every numeral in src-0020 key_claims[1] re-verified exact, and every other stored quotation in src-0020 key_claims[0], [1] and [2] returned PRESENT under exact-string ask this cycle: the 0.22 micro-F1 sentence, the 2,076/114/2,028/211 dataset sentence (which the base stores COMPLETE, including the 'totaling 2,028 technique occurrences across 211 potential candidates' tail), the 211-technique parent-granularity sentence, and the DFIR Report generalisation caveat. src-0020 key_claims[2](a) also re-verified clean on 2026-08-01: arxiv.org/abs/2606.18166 still lists '[v1] Tue, 16 Jun 2026 17:04:15 UTC (25 KB)' as its only version and still carries NO 'Comments:' and NO 'Journal reference:' line, so the unreviewed-v1 limit stands and the version-staleness bolt-on is discharged for this source at cycle 47. THE QUALITATIVE POINT ALSO SURVIVES -- that trained annotators on parent-level ATT&CK labelling agree substantially but well short of near-perfect -- AND IT IS INDEPENDENTLY REINFORCED BY A NUMBER THIS BASE HAD NEVER RECORDED: 981 of 2,076 sentences (47.3%, cycle-47 derivation from two printed numbers) required relabelling as 'low-agreement (K<0.7)'. That figure is measured over the WHOLE corpus, not over a sample, and it is a stronger and cleaner piece of evidence for contested-annotation than the 0.68 mean is. WHAT DOES NOT SURVIVE. The claim that estimand (1) is 'measured over an unrestricted item set' (ctr-0015) is WITHDRAWN. ALL THREE of the pooled kappa values are now known to be restricted or aggregated in some way: a mean of 114 per-technique kappas from a 195-sentence sample (src-0020), a whole-corpus kappa (src-0021, 0.76), and a pairwise kappa over an adjudication-selected contested subset (src-0021, 0.74). The '0.68-0.76 band' framing is therefore worse off than ctr-0015 left it, and the phrase 'two teams, two corpora, one conclusion' must not be used. RESOLUTION PATH, FOUR STEPS. (i) DONE AT CYCLE 47: append a key_claim to src-0020 in state/knowledge/index.json recording the whole six-phase paragraph, the sample restriction, the phase-(ii) tension and the 981/2,076 relabelling figure. (ii) DONE AT CYCLE 47: append the same to state/knowledge/src-0020.md -- done in the SAME cycle as (i), following cycle 46's example, because this is the step ctr-0011, ctr-0012, ctr-0013 and ctr-0014 EACH left undone on their own source files and deferral is why they are still undone. (iii) NOT DONE: repair the 'one band / one conclusion' wording in ttp-attack-mapping-reliability open_questions[1], which is T3 work and is now demanded by BOTH ctr-0015 step (iii) and this entry; a single T3 edit discharges both. (iv) NOT DONE: establish whether the 0.68 was recomputed after phase (iv), which limb 2 leaves open -- the cheapest route is the paper's Table I/annotation section under a fresh exact-string ask for 'recomputed', 'improved to' and 'final agreement', and per rule (v) any ABSENT needs a second URL form. - (task-dependent-reliability-framing) THE STATED GROUND FOR CALLING src-0005 A NON-COMMENSURABLE INSTANCE IS INCOMPLETE: THE BENCHMARK ALSO REPORTS A PARTIAL-CREDIT SET-OVERLAP METRIC. Opened by the cycle-48 T5 under G2, on the base's STALEST source (last checked cycle 26, twenty-two cycles). THE CLAIM IN CONFLICT, verbatim from ctr-0009's description in this same graph, which enumerates 'SEVEN documented non-commensurable instances in this base' and names as the third of them: 'src-0005's all-or-nothing multi-select'. The same characterisation is carried in scores.json's ttp-attack-mapping-reliability rationale, verbatim: 'src-0005's two ranges are real but are all-or-nothing multi-select accuracies, not commensurable with an F1 over free-form extraction'. WHAT THE SOURCE ACTUALLY SAYS. src-0005 reports TWO metrics per benchmark, not one. The stored one is the all-or-nothing accuracy, verbatim and re-verified PRESENT this cycle: 'Evaluation is based on accuracy: the share of questions for which the system selects all correct options and only the correct options'. The unstored one appears in body text in BOTH benchmark sections, verbatim: 'Additional summary statistics of model performance on this benchmark including Jaccard similarity score (which allows partial credit for multiple choice selections that overlap imperfectly with the correct set of answers) can be found in Appendix E.' -- and the same clause pointing to Appendix A for malware analysis. It is reported PER MODEL with confidence intervals, per Figure 12's caption ('average Jaccard Score (over set of model provided responses and correct responses to multiple choice questions) for each model under test ... Error bars reflect 95% confidence intervals computed using a normal approximation') and Figure 16's ('average Jaccard index of model responses with the set of correct responses (teal)'). WHY THIS IS A CONFLICT AND NOT MERELY A GAP. Jaccard over sets and F1 over sets are monotone transforms of one another (J = F1/(2-F1)), so src-0005 does report a set-overlap statistic of the SAME FAMILY as the F1 measures against which the state declares it non-commensurable. The state's reason -- that this instrument awards no partial credit -- is FALSE OF THE INSTRUMENT AS A WHOLE, though true of the one metric the state happened to record. THE VERDICT MAY WELL SURVIVE ON A BETTER GROUND, AND NO CYCLE MAY SILENTLY SWAP ONE FOR THE OTHER: src-0005's Jaccard is computed over a CLOSED, SMALL multiple-choice option set while src-0002's CTI-ATE F1 and src-0007's precision/recall are computed over OPEN free-form extraction, which is a genuine non-commensurability and is NOT the one asserted. REPAIR STEPS. (i) Amend ctr-0009's 'src-0005's all-or-nothing multi-select' entry in the seven-instance list to state the closed-option-set ground rather than the partial-credit ground -- T3 or T4 work, and note ctr-0009 remains open on its own separate merits, which this entry does not touch. (ii) Amend the same characterisation in scores.json's ttp-attack-mapping-reliability rationale. (iii) Re-examine whether the instance COUNT of seven is still right once the ground changes, since the list is cited as evidence of a base-wide pattern. (iv) NOT ACHIEVABLE BY THIS AGENT AND RECORDED SO IT IS NOT RE-ATTEMPTED BLIND: no numeric Jaccard value appears in the document text at all -- every per-model value, accuracy and Jaccard alike, is inside a figure image, re-confirming cycle 26's permanent-limit finding. The commensurable number EXISTS and cannot be read without OCR or released raw results. BEARING ON POLICY QUESTION [97]: this is direct evidence that a non-commensurability finding can rest on a mischaracterised instrument, which is a reason to hold such findings to the same verification standard as positive claims rather than crediting them as resolutions.
- (automated-triage-under-refusal) DERIVED-RATE CONFLICT PLUS UNSOURCED-GROUND-TRUTH-PROVENANCE CONFLICT on src-0007's triage figures, opened by cycle 53's G2 re-verification of src-0007 (arXiv 2603.09452, CyberThreat-Eval), the stalest source in the base at twenty-three cycles. THIS ENTRY IS THE FIRST OPEN CONTRADICTION EVER FILED AGAINST automated-triage-under-refusal, so unlike ctr-0020 it DOES create new G3 gate pressure: this issue's ceiling falls from 5 to 3. THE STATE'S CLAIMS, in five places, all traceable to one reading of Table 4: (a) state/knowledge/index.json src-0007 key_claims[2], verbatim 'Automated triage showed an extreme precision/recall asymmetry (recall Accepted 0.90-1.00 but precision Accepted 0.27-0.40 across all four models): the models accept nearly everything a human analyst would reject.'; (b) state/knowledge/src-0007.md numbered claim 3, verbatim '...the models accept nearly everything, so the triage stage as automated here would pass through roughly 2 of every 3 items that a human analyst rejects.'; (c) this issue's open_questions[1], verbatim 'src-0007's ground truth IS the human analyst's accept/reject decision, so by construction it carries no human error bar and cannot tell us whether human triage would score better on its own benchmark.'; (d) this issue's open_questions[2], verbatim 'if automated triage accepts 60-73% of what human analysts reject, it is precisely the wrong instrument for the volume problem it is most often proposed to solve'; (e) this issue's candidate_resolutions[0], verbatim 'the decision threshold is set so permissively that the system accepts or acts on most of what a human analyst would reject'. DEFECT 1, ARITHMETIC, AND THIS IS THE STRONGER HALF. Precision (Accepted) is TP/(TP+FP). At precision 0.27-0.40 the quantity 0.60-0.73 is the share of the items the system ACCEPTS that the ground truth had rejected. The state converts it into the share of TRUE REJECTS that get passed through, i.e. FP/(FP+TN), and states that as fact in (b) and (d). These are different quantities and the second is NOT derivable from precision and recall alone -- it needs the class base rate, which src-0007 never reports. They are also demonstrably unequal here: with recall (Accepted) at 0.9091-1.0000 and precision about 0.30, FP is about 2.33 times TP, so the corpus must contain at least 2.33 true rejects per true accept; FP/(FP+TN) then equals 0.60-0.73 only if true rejects happen to outnumber true accepts by about 3.4 to 1, and equals 100% if the ratio is exactly 2.33 to 1. Nothing in the paper fixes that ratio. THE DEFENSIBLE RESTATEMENT is 'roughly 2 of every 3 items the system accepts are items the ground truth rejected'; the pass-through rate of true rejects is UNCOMPUTABLE from the published figures. This is the rule (xii) shape -- a derived number that no cycle audited against the log that derived it -- and the derivation is not merely unlogged but invalid. DEFECT 2, PROVENANCE, WEAKER BUT STRUCTURALLY LOAD-BEARING. Claim (c) asserts that src-0007's triage ground truth IS the human analyst's own accept/reject decision, and then reasons FROM that premise to the conclusion that the benchmark 'by construction carries no human error bar'. A verification-mode fetch put the question directly to BOTH renderings -- quote verbatim every sentence describing how the triage ground-truth labels were produced, who labelled the articles, and by what process -- and BOTH returned ABSENT. The paper does not say. The abstract does call the benchmark 'expert-annotated' and says it is 'collected from the daily CTI workflow of a world-leading company', so the state's reading is PLAUSIBLE and I do not assert it is wrong; I assert that it is an INFERENCE recorded as a fact, and that an open question which draws a structural conclusion from it must say so. WHAT PASSES, recorded plainly so this entry is not misread as a wholesale rejection of src-0007: every NUMBER re-verifies. Exact strings '0.3982', '0.2717' and '1.0000' are PRESENT in both renderings; the stored ranges precision (Accepted) 0.2717-0.3982 and recall (Accepted) 0.9091-1.0000 stand unchanged for a fourth independent pull; and the stored body sentence 'For article classification, LLMs exhibit high recall (often >0.90), indicating strong sensitivity to potentially relevant articles.' is PRESENT verbatim in both. The authors' own gloss runs in the same DIRECTION as the state's -- 'However, precision remains low (typically <0.40), reflecting a tendency to over-accept, which may increase analysts' workload.' -- but note that the authors say 'may increase analysts' workload', which is materially weaker than the state's operational claim about what the harness would pass through. THIRD FINDING FROM THE SAME PULL, SEPARATE FROM THE TWO DEFECTS, rule (iv) paragraph-first-word-to-last-word: state/knowledge/src-0007.md stores ONE sentence of a FIVE-sentence paragraph under the heading 'Body sentence accompanying the triage rows, verbatim'. The four uncaptured sentences contain a metric that appears NOWHERE in this entire knowledge base: 'For priority scoring, models achieve 55-60% accuracy, with fine-tuned variants like GPT-4o (FT) and GPT-4o-mini (FT) occasionally aligning more closely with expert judgments.' That corresponds to Table 4's previously-unused 'Pass Rate (Score)' rows, verbatim on the second rendering as Description 0.566 / 0.550 / 0.600 / 0.590 and Article 0.566 / 0.580 / 0.590 / 0.600. WHY IT MATTERS: the state labels the asymmetry 'Triage-stage PRIORITY SCORING shows an extreme precision/recall asymmetry', whereas the paper's own body attributes those precision/recall numbers to ARTICLE CLASSIFICATION and reports priority scoring separately at 55-60% accuracy. Table 4 does file both under the task name 'Priority Scoring (Description)' and 'Priority Scoring (Article)', so the paper is itself the source of the ambiguity and this is not charged against it -- but the state has collapsed two distinct measurements under one label and holds only one of them. METRIC DEFINITION RECOVERED, rule (iii), never before in this base, quoted with the paper's double quotes rendered as single: 'In this task, LLMs are asked to determine whether an article should be -accepted- (i.e., if it provides valid, actionable subject and target information about a threat incident-sufficient to support identifying threat actors, root causes, etc.) or -rejected- (if it lacks relevant or actionable insights) for further analysis.' and 'For articles in the -accepted- category, the task is to assign an appropriate priority score that reflects the severity and urgency of the incident.' The hyphens stand for the paper's quotation marks. VERIFICATION PERFORMED, per rules (v), (xiii), (xv), (xvi) and (xvii): two URL forms, arxiv.org/html/2603.09452v1 and arxiv.org/html/2603.09452, fetched on 2026-08-01, each in verification-mode with numbered PRESENT/ABSENT items, an instruction to answer ABSENT rather than substitute a similar sentence, an ITEM 0 section-visibility probe and a final truncation probe (the cycle-52 hardening). BOTH confirmed they could see the triage sections and BOTH self-reported NOT truncated, so rule (xvi) voids nothing here and the ABSENT verdict on ground-truth provenance is confirmed on two independent URL forms as rule (v) requires. REPAIR STEPS, NONE PERFORMED BEYOND (i), because a T4 scores and does not investigate. (i) DONE AT CYCLE 53: this entry, plus an appended 'Cycle 53' section in state/knowledge/src-0007.md and appended key_claims in state/knowledge/index.json recording the full paragraph, the metric definition, the Pass Rate rows and the TMLR provenance. NOTHING WAS DELETED OR REWRITTEN. (ii) A FUTURE T3 SHOULD correct the derived rate in locations (b) and (d) to the defensible restatement above and record FP/(FP+TN) as uncomputable from the published figures. (iii) A FUTURE T3 SHOULD requalify open_questions[1]'s premise as an inference, or find the sentence that establishes it. (iv) A FUTURE T3 SHOULD wire the 55-60% priority-scoring accuracy and the Pass Rate (Score) rows into this issue, since they measure the task the issue is named after and this base has never used them. (v) NOTE UNDER CARRY-FORWARD [41]: src-0007 is cited by candidates in five different issues, so the single issue_id field is lossy again; this entry is filed against automated-triage-under-refusal because that is where the mis-derived rate is used as a resolution.
- (ttp-attack-mapping-reliability) THE src-0017 ARTEFACT CONTAINS AT LEAST FOUR TTP SCORING VARIANTS ACROSS TWO MODULES; THIS BASE'S STORED DIRECTORY LISTING RECORDS ONLY ONE MODULE, AND THE CONCLUSION BUILT ON IT IS PHRASED WITH THE DEFINITE ARTICLE. Opened by cycle 55's G2 -- the first re-verification of src-0017 in twenty-three cycles (last checked cycle 32) and the first ever to look OUTSIDE the two files cycles 27 and 31 happened to choose. This is the rule (vi) shape, THE SOURCE IS CLEAN AND THE STATE'S ACCOUNT OF IT IS NOT, and it is also the rule (viii) shape, because the defective part was never quoted from the artefact at all and no string check could have caught it: every string this base stores about compute.py re-verified PRESENT again this cycle. WHAT THE STATE SAYS. src-0017 key_claims[5] stores, verbatim: 'Directory listing obtained from the GitHub contents API: stage3_ti_drafting/ttp/ holds README.md, data/, eval/ and example/, and eval/ holds exactly one file, compute.py.' This issue's candidate_resolutions[2] then opens, verbatim and with the definite article: 'THE ATT&CK/TTP SCORING RULE BEHIND src-0007's TTP NUMBERS IS NOW KNOWN, READ OFF EXECUTING CODE', and concludes 'SO THE RULE IS EXACT STRING EQUALITY OF TECHNIQUE IDS, VIA SET INTERSECTION.' WHAT THE SOURCE SAYS. The GitHub trees API at api.github.com/repos/xschen-beb/CyberThreat-Eval/git/trees/main?recursive=true, which reports its own truncated field as FALSE, lists FIVE children of stage3_ti_drafting/ttp/: README.md (16,236 bytes), data/, eval/, example/ AND utils/. THE STORED LISTING OMITS utils/. utils/ holds one file, eval_ttps_utils.py, at 31,268 bytes -- 2.3 times the 13,636 bytes of eval/compute.py, which is the file candidate_resolutions[2] rests on entirely. THE DEFECT, IN THREE LIMBS. LIMB 1 -- THE OMISSION IS THE STATE'S, NOT A LATER REPO CHANGE, AND CYCLE 55 CHECKED THIS RATHER THAN ASSUMING IT. The commits API for that exact path (api.github.com/repos/xschen-beb/CyberThreat-Eval/commits?path=stage3_ti_drafting/ttp/utils/eval_ttps_utils.py) returns EXACTLY ONE commit: sha d3a32c0252c8eb86ecc4dbeb4eabda1ffbb7ee21, author date 2025-12-18T07:51:24Z, message 'remove benchmark folder and refine README.md'. That date precedes every cycle of this project, so the file was present when cycle 31 enumerated the directory and when cycle 32 re-verified it. THE STORED LISTING WAS INCOMPLETE WHEN WRITTEN. NOTE, so this entry is not over-read: cycle 31's narrower sub-claim 'eval/ holds exactly one file, compute.py' IS STILL TRUE and is NOT impeached -- the missed file sits in a SIBLING directory, not inside eval/. LIMB 2 -- FOUR SCORING VARIANTS, NOT ONE. eval_ttps_utils.py was read at TWO different URL forms (raw.githubusercontent.com on main, and the same path pinned to sha d3a32c02). Both returned an IDENTICAL twelve-entry list of top-level def lines, of which FOUR are precision/recall computations: 'def compute_precision_recall(articles, client, model_name):', 'def compute_raw_precision_recall(articles, client, model_name):', 'def compute_mapping_precision_recall(articles, client, model_name):' and 'def compute_raw_with_mapping_precision_recall(articles, client, model_name):'. A THIRD render, the github.com blob HTML form, independently reported the same four names. So the artefact offers at least four TTP scoring rules and this base had read one module containing one. WHICH OF THEM PRODUCED src-0007's TABLE 4 IS UNKNOWN, and this COMPOUNDS rather than replaces the inference gap already standing in this issue's open_questions[4]: previously the paper merely failed to state that compute.py produced Table 4; now there are at least four candidates it also fails to choose between. Two of the four are named 'raw' and two 'mapping', a distinction this base has no reading of. LIMB 3 -- WHAT IS CORROBORATED RATHER THAN OVERTURNED, PUT FIRST AND PLAINLY SO THIS ENTRY IS NOT OVER-READ IN THE DESTRUCTIVE DIRECTION. candidate_resolutions[2]'s CENTRAL STRICTNESS FINDING SURVIVES AND IS NOW INDEPENDENTLY REPLICATED IN A SECOND FILE. The exact string 'tp = len(article_ttps_set.intersection(validated_ttps_set))' returned PRESENT in eval_ttps_utils.py at ALL THREE renders. The exact string 'fp = len(validated_ttps_set - article_ttps_set) + missing_in_mapping_count' returned PRESENT at TWO renders. The ground-truth set is reported as being built by the same split-on-space-hyphen-space comprehension with the same membership filter in all four functions (ONE render only, so labelled as such and not relied on). And BOTH the raw render and the sha-pinned render were asked DIRECTLY whether the file contains any logic splitting a technique ID on a dot, or awarding parent-technique credit for a sub-technique prediction; BOTH answered ABSENT. So exact-ID set intersection with NO partial credit is a property of BOTH modules, and this issue's strictness conclusion is STRONGER after this cycle, not weaker. Both renders also agree that main() calls compute_mapping_precision_recall(articles, client, model_name) -- the variant whose fp INCLUDES missing_in_mapping_count, i.e. the one matching compute.py's stored formula. WHAT DOES NOT SURVIVE IS THE SINGULARITY. 'THE ATT&CK/TTP SCORING RULE ... IS NOW KNOWN' must henceforth be read as: a scoring rule, shared by the two modules read so far in its tp construction and in its refusal of partial credit, is known; WHICH of at least four variants produced the published figures is not. A RENDER DISAGREEMENT, RECORDED RATHER THAN RESOLVED, AND NO CLAIM IS BUILT ON IT. The three fetches CONFLICT on the fn assignments. The sha-pinned render answered ABSENT for the exact string 'fn = len(article_ttps_set - validated_ttps_set)', which is compute.py's stored and twice-verified fn line; the first raw render quoted that very line as present; the blob-HTML render instead reported an fn of the form len(article_ttps_set) - tp - fp for three of the four functions. Under rule (ix) a disagreement of this kind makes ALL THREE readings unusable, so NO fn line from eval_ttps_utils.py is stored by this entry and none may be quoted from it until some cycle resolves the conflict. THE POSSIBILITY THAT MATTERS IF IT IS REAL: an fn defined as len(article_ttps_set) - tp - fp is NOT the same quantity as len(article_ttps_set - validated_ttps_set), and can even go negative, which would make the recall DENOMINATORS of the variants differ from one another. NOBODY MAY ASSUME EITHER READING. RESOLUTION PATH, FOUR STEPS. (i) DONE AT CYCLE 55: this entry, plus the cycle-55 update block appended to this issue's open_questions[4] recording the utils/ discovery and the worked-example ground-truth format. (ii) NOT DONE: append a key_claim to src-0017 in state/knowledge/index.json AND the same text to state/knowledge/src-0017.md, recording the five-child directory listing with byte sizes, the four function names, the commit date, and the corroborated tp / no-partial-credit findings. THIS IS THE STEP ctr-0011, ctr-0012, ctr-0013 AND ctr-0014 EACH LEFT UNDONE ON THEIR OWN SOURCE FILES, and cycle 55 is leaving it undone too -- for turn budget and for no better reason. A successor should treat it as the cheapest available repair and should note that cycles 46 and 47 succeeded precisely because they did it in the SAME cycle as the finding. (iii) NOT DONE: annotate candidate_resolutions[2]'s opening sentence IN PLACE so its definite article does not travel unqualified, in the same annotate-do-not-delete style as this cycle's open_questions[1] repair. (iv) NOT DONE: resolve the fn render conflict and establish what distinguishes the 'raw' variants from the 'mapping' variants, which is the only route to saying which rule produced Table 4. Two cheap untried routes, both small enough to fetch whole: stage3_ti_drafting/ttp/example/simple_test.py (7,953 bytes) and stage3_ti_drafting/ttp/README.md (16,236 bytes). WHAT IS NOT DAMAGED, AND IT IS THE LARGER PART -- THE CONCLUSION SURVIVES. key_claims[0]'s conclusion is that this benchmark measures NO ELICITED CONFIDENCE CONSTRUCT and scores its attribution-family tasks by CORRECTNESS ONLY. The recovered occurrence does not touch it: 'low-confidence samples' refers to FILTERING BENCHMARK-CONSTRUCTION DATA by an LLM judge's rubric score during dataset assembly, not to eliciting a confidence from an evaluated model. That is precisely the distinction cycle 49 itself drew when it recorded 'probability' as its one PRESENT and correctly declined to count it. Independently re-checked this cycle on TWO new URL forms neither previously used -- https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2510.11974 (serving v1) and the explicit v2 URL: 'calibration' ABSENT on BOTH; 'abstain'/'abstention' ABSENT on ar5iv/v1; and no prompt-template instruction to state a confidence, probability, certainty or likelihood on either. SO src-0023 REMAINS VALID EVIDENCE FOR THE NEGATIVE IT WAS COLLECTED TO ESTABLISH, and a T4 must NOT demote this issue's merit on the strength of this entry. WHAT IS DAMAGED IS THE EVIDENTIARY STANDING OF EXHAUSTIVE-SWEEP VERDICTS IN THIS BASE, AND THAT IS THE REASON THIS ENTRY EXISTS RATHER THAN A FOOTNOTE. A thirteen-string exhaustive sweep reported in a single fetch is a THIRTEEN-FOLD ABSENT CLAIM resting on one render's compliance, and one of the thirteen is now known false. Under rule (v) an ABSENT requires a second URL form; cycle 49 obtained a second form for the v1 render but the thirteen-string sweep was run ONCE, on ONE form. THE GENERAL LESSON, OFFERED AS A CANDIDATE METHODOLOGICAL RULE (xxii) AND NOT IMPOSED: A BATCHED ABSENT IS WEAKER THAN A SINGLE ABSENT, NOT STRONGER. Asking one fetch for thirteen exact strings at once invites it to answer the QUESTION ('does this paper measure confidence?') rather than the THIRTEEN STRING QUERIES, and a compound word like 'low-confidence' is exactly what a question-answering read drops and a string-matching read catches. Prefer few strings per fetch, and treat any sweep of more than about five strings as a SINGLE ABSENT about the concept rather than as N independent string absences. A SECOND, CONFIRMING INSTANCE OF THE SAME HAZARD WAS OBSERVED IN THIS VERY CYCLE, which is why the rule is offered with some confidence: the ar5iv fetch, asked for the exact string 'confidence', answered PRESENT and quoted a sentence NOT CONTAINING THE WORD ('The judge returns a single holistic score in [1,5]. ...'). - (consistency-calibration-as-failure-mode) MODALITY MISMATCH: THE STATE RECORDS ITS TWO CALIBRATION SOURCES AS MEASURING CONFIDENCE IN THE SAME MODALITY. THEY MEASURE IT IN OPPOSITE MODALITIES. Opened by cycle 62's T3 while discharging ctr-0026 step (iv), which asked whether the bullet ctr-0026 impeached still supports its comparability claim. It does not, and the reason is a limb ctr-0026 did not examine. THE CLAIMS IN CONFLICT. (a) state/knowledge/src-0013.md, 'Limitations of this source', fourth bullet -- the SAME bullet ctr-0026 impeached, now failing on a second and independent ground -- verbatim: 'Calibration is measured on VERBALIZED confidence (the model stating a confidence number), which is the same modality as src-0001's, so the two are methodologically comparable -- but verbalized confidence is known to behave differently from token-probability-derived confidence, and no result here transfers automatically to logit-based uncertainty.' The clause 'which is the same modality as src-0001's, so the two are methodologically comparable' ASSERTS THAT src-0001 ELICITS VERBALIZED CONFIDENCE. (b) SRC-0001 DERIVES CONFIDENCE FROM TOKEN LOG PROBABILITIES. Verbatim from arxiv.org/html/2503.23175v2, section 5 'Evaluation Metrics', returned under a verification-mode prompt that asked how a confidence value is elicited and permitted an ABSENT answer: 'We implement calibration analysis by extracting the log probabilities that the LLM assigns to the tokens composing the generated response. Considering that the response is in the JSON format, and each field of the JSON file corresponds to a different entity, we isolate the tokens and the probabilities of each section of the JSON file corresponding to a specific entity, multiply the token probabilities of that JSON file section, and derive the overall confidence for each entity.' The same fetch returned the exact string 'log probability' PRESENT with the containing clause 'log probabilities that the LLM assigns to the tokens' and 'token probability' PRESENT with 'multiply the token probabilities of that JSON file section'. THE EVIDENTIAL STATUS, STATED PRECISELY RATHER THAN BANKED. This entry stands on a PRESENT verdict from ONE URL form, which rule (v) licenses, and the returned passage survives the rule (xvii) post-check because it contains the very strings the fetch was separately asked for. It does NOT stand on the accompanying ABSENT verdicts -- 'verbalized' ABSENT and 'self-reported' ABSENT in src-0001 -- because those are single-form and rule (v) requires a second URL form for an ABSENT. THOSE TWO ABSENTS ARE CORROBORATING, NOT LOAD-BEARING, and a successor wanting them at full strength should confirm on a second form. The contradiction does not need them: a paper that computes confidence by multiplying token probabilities is not eliciting verbalized confidence whether or not it also uses the word. WHY THIS IS MATERIAL AND NOT A TAXONOMIC QUIBBLE -- AND IT IS MATERIAL PRECISELY BECAUSE OF WHAT CYCLE 62 MEASURED IN THE SAME PASS. ctr-0026's step (iii) prize, pulled this cycle and recorded in candidate_resolutions[6] of this issue, shows that WITHIN src-0013's OWN STUDY, on ONE benchmark (SALLM, n=2,000 per temperature), for ONE model, at the SAME temperature, switching the confidence-elicitation method from Verbalized to Token Probability moves ECE from 0.25 to 0.81 for Gemini-2.0-Flash and from 0.46 to 0.80 for GPT-4o-mini -- gaps of 0.56 and 0.34, confirmed cell-for-cell on THREE URL forms. So the base has been holding two studies 'methodologically comparable' across exactly the degree of freedom that one of those two studies measures as the single largest source of variation in the quantity being compared. It is larger than any ECE-versus-Brier gap recorded anywhere in this base, and larger than most of the between-model gaps this base treats as findings. THIS IS THE RULE (vi) SHAPE -- BOTH SOURCES ARE CLEAN, THE STATE'S ACCOUNT OF THEM IS NOT -- AND IT IS THE FIFTEENTH INSTANCE. It is also the second defect found in a single bullet in two consecutive cycles, which is itself worth noting: ctr-0026 caught the bullet's last clause and stopped there, and the false premise sat one clause earlier in the same sentence. CONSEQUENCE, WHICH IS WHY THIS IS LOAD-BEARING AND NOT PEDANTIC. An underdetermined report answered with a wildly wrong actor lands in INCORRECT, not in PLAUSIBLE, because the third category absorbs 'misjudgment, hallucination, or spurious correlation' regardless of whether the report was determinate. The plausible/incorrect boundary is therefore a joint property of (report, model output) and the partition induces NO model-independent labelling of reports by evidential determinacy. The candidate's proposed test is 'whether confidence-in-analytic-judgment tracks EVIDENTIAL DETERMINACY while likelihood tracks correctness'; that test needs a determinacy label on the REPORT, fixed before any model is run. Correlating a model's expressed confidence against a bucket whose membership already depends on that model's own answer is partly circular, and the circularity runs in the flattering direction -- a model whose answers are plausible-but-wrong is placed in the very bucket that would be scored as correctly-low-determinacy. - (consistency-calibration-as-failure-mode) METHODOLOGICAL CONFLICT BETWEEN SUPPORTED CLAIMS, opened by cycle 79 (T2) under hard rule 3, on evidence collected by cycle 78. IT IS THE FIRST CONTRADICTION IN THIS BASE WHOSE TWO SIDES ARE A MEASUREMENT SOURCE AND A METHODOLOGY SOURCE RATHER THAN TWO MEASUREMENTS, AND THE DIFFERENCE MATTERS FOR HOW IT MAY BE RESOLVED. SIDE ONE, src-0001, verbatim: 'The ECE and BS, are two measures of calibration that quantify the deviation from perfect calibration.' This sentence is in the knowledge base, is the definitional warrant under which src-0001's Table 6 prints ECE and Brier side by side, and is the FOUNDING PREMISE of this issue's open_questions[6] -- nine cycles old, twice narrowed, and named in two downstream issues as required reading before citing src-0001's extraction-versus-generation split. SIDE TWO, src-0028 and src-0029, two independent teams at two peer-reviewed venues. src-0028 abstract verbatim: 'Every proper score decomposes into two fundamental components -- proper calibration error and refinement -- utilizing a Bregman divergence.' src-0029 Section 3 verbatim: 'Both Brier score and log-loss are strictly proper scoring rules', with Section 3.1 giving the same decomposition into calibration loss and refinement loss. TAKEN TOGETHER THESE ENTAIL THAT THE BRIER SCORE IS NOT A PURE CALIBRATION MEASURE: it carries a refinement (sharpness) term that a calibration error does not, so two systems with identical calibration error can carry different Brier scores and the Brier score does not 'quantify the deviation from perfect calibration' in the sense src-0001's sentence asserts. THE ENTAILMENT IS AN INFERENCE AND IS LABELLED ONE: neither src-0028 nor src-0029 names ECE, and the step requires the premise that ECE estimates a calibration error, which is what ECE is by construction but is not a quotation from either source. NEITHER SIDE IS PICKED, PER HARD RULE 3, AND CYCLE 79 RECORDS THAT THE ASYMMETRY BETWEEN THE SIDES IS UNUSUAL AND CUTS BOTH WAYS. AGAINST src-0001: it is a single sentence of definitional framing rather than a measurement; two independent peer-reviewed methodology sources contradict it; and the decomposition is standard, old and traceable to Murphy and Winkler (1977) on src-0029's own account, so this is settled ground in the calibration literature rather than a live dispute. FOR src-0001, AND THIS IS NOT NOTHING: neither src-0028 nor src-0029 was written about LLMs, about security, or about src-0001; neither has read src-0001; and a loose definitional sentence in a paper's methods section is not necessarily a claim the paper's numbers depend on. THE HONEST STATEMENT OF THE CONFLICT IS THEREFORE NARROW: src-0001's SENTENCE is wrong as stated, and what follows for src-0001's NUMBERS is a separate question this entry does not answer. WHY IT IS FILED RATHER THAN LEFT AS A CANDIDATE. Cycle 78 collected the evidence, declined to open this, and expressly left the judgement to cycle 79, on the ground that a T1 opening a contradiction on its own collection would be doing T2 work and that the conflict is with a methodological assertion rather than a measurement. CYCLE 79 JUDGES THAT IT MUST BE FILED. Hard rule 3 conditions on two SUPPORTED CLAIMS IN CONFLICT and does not exempt methodological ones; the sentence is load-bearing precisely because an entire open_question was built on it; and this base's own history is that an unfiled conflict is an invisible one -- see carry-forward [217], where evidence entered into the graph alone escaped every grep-based technique this loop depends on. WHAT THIS DOES NOT DO. It does NOT withdraw any src-0001 number, it does NOT resolve open_questions[6], and it does NOT give this issue a second CTI calibration source: src-0028 and src-0029 measure no LLM and no security task and can NEVER be counted toward CTI multi-source support under the cycle-16 scope ruling. A T4 must not read this entry as evidence that the issue's calibration leg has strengthened; if anything it weakens what src-0001's Table 6 can be asked to show. REPAIR PATH. (iii) Answer open_questions[9], which asks whether the refinement term quantitatively explains the Table 6 outlier row cycle 75 isolated; note that open_questions[9] records this as NOT answerable from this base, because src-0001 prints no refinement term and releases no artefact. Evidence-gated action rate (EGAR) is the fraction of containment actions preceded by fetching trusted evidence about the target entity; it measures whether the model checks before it acts. Time-to-first-containment (TTFC) is the step index of the first containment action; higher values indicate more investigation before acting.' SO ctr-0042's SENTENCE 'This base has therefore carried 82.5 / 65 / 57.5 / 45 percent for sixty-six cycles WITHOUT KNOWING THEIR DENOMINATOR' IS WRONG. The denominator is EPISODES -- n = 40 standard-tier episodes per model, a figure this base already held. An agent taking twenty correct containments and one incorrect one in an episode scores IDENTICALLY to an agent taking a single incorrect containment. ===== WHERE THE IMPACT CONJUNCT COMES FROM. STATED AS A HYPOTHESIS AND NOT AS A FINDING. The only place the word 'impact' appears in this issue's definition is its ID: institutional-incident-real-world-impact. This graph has direct precedent that an id here can be LEGACY and non-descriptive. At cycle 45 a T2 retitled attribution-confident-wrong-gap to its error-rate leg while KEEPING the id, and recorded in that issue's open_questions[3] that the id 'no longer describes its own contents', because the string was cited from three append-only files (state/knowledge/index.json, src-0002.md, src-0017.md) and renaming it would strand those references with no legal repair. AN ID STRING IN THIS GRAPH IS THEREFORE NOT AUTHORITATIVE FOR AN ISSUE'S CONTENT, and reading a scoring requirement out of one is a known hazard in this very state. Whether that is what happened here is exactly what this entry does not decide.

===== THE COMPETING READINGS, WHICH IS WHY THIS IS A CONTRADICTION AND NOT A CORRECTION. READING ONE: the title governs, the impact conjunct is an artefact of the id, and the issue has been under-scored. READING TWO: 'reached production/publication at real institutions' IS ITSELF the impact claim -- the contrast being with benchmark or laboratory failures -- so the id is accurate, 'impact' means occurrence-in-production, and the base documents it well. UNDER READING TWO THE ASSESSMENTS ARE ALSO WRONG TO PIN, but for the opposite reason: not because the conjunct is absent but because it is SATISFIED. READING THREE: the assessments are right, and the title is an incomplete statement of an issue that has always been about downstream consequences, in which case THE TITLE is what needs amending and the score is correct. I DO NOT PICK BETWEEN THESE. A T2 may retitle an issue -- cycle 45 did -- and cycle 100 DELIBERATELY DID NOT RETITLE, because every available retitle smuggles in one side of this dispute and would destroy the evidence for settling it.

Under readings one and two this issue is under-scored by at least one point and has been for at least ten cycles (91, 94, 97 explicitly, and the pinning is traced to cycle 76). THIS ENTRY IS A CANDIDATE CAUSE OF ONE OF THOSE STUCK VALUES RATHER THAN ANOTHER SYMPTOM OF IT, which is the reason it is worth an entry at all.

- (task-dependent-reliability-framing) SELECTOR-RULE MISAPPLICATION, OPENED BY CYCLE 133's T5 AS ITS G2 RETROSPECTION ON CYCLE 124. This is not a conflict about the world and NO SOURCE IS IMPLICATED. It is a conflict between a conclusion cycle 124 ENTERED INTO state/queue/next_task.json at commit 57732b0 and what state/issues/graph.json said at that same commit's parent. ZERO FETCHES were spent; the entry is re-derivable from the repository at zero cost. (1) WHAT CYCLE 124 ENTERED. Cycle 124 was a T5, and a T5 enters almost nothing into the state, so the conclusion under test is its SELECTION: state/queue/next_task.json at 57732b0 records task_type T3 and target_issue 'task-dependent-reliability-framing'. logs/cycle-124.md records the ground verbatim: 'Tie-break (a) upstream-first is inert in this graph: I checked depend_on on all ten issues and every one is null, so no issue outranks another on dependency and (a) has never separated anything here.' (2) WHY IT FAILS. THE FIELD NAME IN THIS FILE IS depends_on, NOT depend_on. prompts/t5_select.md rung 3(a) spells the word 'depend_on' inside an English sentence -- 'Upstream first: an issue that others depend_on outranks its dependents' -- and cycle 124 queried that string as though it were the field name. THE INSTRUMENT WAS REPRODUCED AT CYCLE 133 BEFORE THE COUNT WAS CALLED WRONG, per carry-forward [337]: jq over .issues[]|.depend_on against 57732b0^:state/issues/graph.json returns null ten times out of ten, EXACTLY as cycle 124 reported. Cycle 124's OBSERVATION is reproducible; its INFERENCE is not. The same snapshot queried on depends_on returns SIX non-empty arrays out of ten -- attribution-confident-wrong-gap [consistency-calibration-as-failure-mode]; attribution-expressed-confidence-unmeasured [attribution-confident-wrong-gap, consistency-calibration-as-failure-mode]; task-dependent-reliability-framing [ttp-attack-mapping-reliability, ioc-extraction-reliability, consistency-calibration-as-failure-mode, attribution-confident-wrong-gap, attribution-expressed-confidence-unmeasured]; extraction-vs-reasoning-ordinal-axis [task-dependent-reliability-framing]; incident-evidence-vendor-concentration [institutional-incident-real-world-impact]. RUNG 3(a) WAS LIVE AT CYCLE 124, NOT INERT. (3) THE CONSEQUENCE FOR THE SELECTION ITSELF, STATED EXACTLY. task-dependent-reliability-framing carries THE LARGEST depends_on IN THE GRAPH -- five upstream issues, four of which (ioc-extraction-reliability, consistency-calibration-as-failure-mode, attribution-confident-wrong-gap, attribution-expressed-confidence-unmeasured) were themselves in the score-2 candidate set at cycle 124. On the STRICT reading of 3(a) (every root outranks every non-root) it is outranked by the four score-2 roots; on the PAIRWISE reading (an issue is outranked by each issue it depends on) it is outranked by all four of those upstreams. ON EITHER READING IT IS ELIMINATED AT THE FIRST TIE-BREAK AND SHOULD NOT HAVE BEEN SELECTED. The correct rung-3(a) survivor set at cycle 124 was the four score-2 issues with EMPTY depends_on: ioc-extraction-reliability, consistency-calibration-as-failure-mode, institutional-incident-real-world-impact, automated-triage-under-refusal. SO THE CORRECT SELECTION IS NOT UNIQUELY DETERMINED EITHER; what IS determined is that cycle 124's winner was not among the survivors at all. (4) WHAT DOES NOT FAIL, STATED SO THAT NO SUCCESSOR OVER-READS THIS ENTRY. The T3 cycle 124 queued DID run, at cycle 125 (commit 8f54b27); it is recorded in task-dependent-reliability-framing's attempts as 125 and it widened that issue's open_questions from three to six. THIS ENTRY DOES NOT IMPEACH CYCLE 125'S FINDINGS, which rest on sources and not on the selector. Nor does it impeach cycle 124's residual-staleness reasoning on its own terms; that reasoning was simply applied to a candidate set rung 3(a) should already have cut. NO SCORE MOVES ON ACCOUNT OF THIS ENTRY: IT IS A PROCESS DEFECT, NOT EVIDENCE. (5) THE DEFECT'S REACH BEYOND CYCLE 124, WHICH IS WHY IT IS WORTH AN ENTRY. Cycles 127 and 130 -- the only two T5s between cycle 124 and cycle 133 -- BOTH treated rung 3(a) as live and BOTH used it to eliminate the non-root issues, so on present evidence the defect is CONFINED TO CYCLE 124 and is not a standing selector behaviour. A successor auditing any T5 EARLIER than cycle 127 should CHECK this rather than assume it. (6) WHAT A SUCCESSOR OWES. (i) A T2 should decide whether rung 3(a) is to be read strictly or pairwise and record the reading in the state; the two readings coincide at cycles 124 and 133 but need not coincide in general. (ii) THE SAME T2 OR A HUMAN SHOULD ADDRESS THE STANDING CONSEQUENCE that cycles 130, 131, 132 and 133 have all recorded: rung 3(a) under EITHER reading permanently excludes every issue with a non-empty depends_on, so the selector can NEVER reach task-dependent-reliability-framing or extraction-vs-reasoning-ordinal-axis -- the two issues that between them carry ctr-0009 step (iii), src-0006's unfetched per-task scoring definitions, which five separate cycles now call the highest-value unfetched item in the whole base. THAT ASSERTION IS FALSE AGAINST THIS FILE -- extraction-vs-reasoning-ordinal-axis's depends_on is [task-dependent-reliability-framing], both at 57732b0^ and at cycle 133 -- SO THE PROPOSED ROUTE DOES NOT EXIST AND CYCLE 133 DID NOT TAKE IT. (iii) NOTE FOR THE SELECTOR: this entry is filed ON task-dependent-reliability-framing because that is the issue whose selection is impeached, but it is a defect of the SELECTION POLICY and not of that issue's evidence. It must not by itself move that issue's score in either direction, and per the ceiling reading of G3 implemented at scripts/validate_state.py lines 144-156 it imposes no further demotion beyond the one that issue's existing open entries already impose. === CYCLE 135 (T2): STEP (6)(i) IS DISCHARGED. THE READING IS PAIRWISE, AND THE STATE NOW RECORDS IT. THE PROMPT TEXT DECIDES IT. prompts/t5_select.md rung 3(a) reads, verbatim and in full: 'Upstream first: an issue that others depend_on outranks its dependents.' THE OBJECT OF 'outranks' IS 'ITS DEPENDENTS' -- the issues that depend on it -- AND NOT 'ALL OTHER ISSUES'. The strict reading, under which every issue with an empty depends_on outranks every issue with a non-empty one, requires a quantifier the sentence does not contain; to license it the rung would have to read 'outranks every dependent issue', AND IT DOES NOT. THE PAIRWISE READING IS THEREFORE THE ONE THE PROMPT LICENSES: rung 3(a) is a PARTIAL ORDER over the tied set, and a T5 applying it should take the MAXIMAL ELEMENTS of that partial order restricted to the score tier under consideration, rather than simply keeping the empty-depends_on issues. WHAT THIS CHANGES AND WHAT IT DOES NOT, WORKED AGAINST THE GRAPH AS OF CYCLE 135 SO THE DECISION IS AUDITABLE RATHER THAN ABSTRACT. IT DOES NOT CHANGE TODAY'S OUTCOME, AND I SAY SO PLAINLY. Scores are ttp-attack-mapping-reliability 3, incident-evidence-vendor-concentration 3, and the other eight at 2, so the tie-break operates within the eight-issue score-2 tier. task-dependent-reliability-framing's depends_on is [ttp-attack-mapping-reliability, ioc-extraction-reliability, consistency-calibration-as-failure-mode, attribution-confident-wrong-gap, attribution-expressed-confidence-unmeasured]; FOUR of those five sit inside the score-2 tier, so it is non-maximal and is cut under the pairwise reading exactly as it is under the strict one. extraction-vs-reasoning-ordinal-axis's depends_on is [task-dependent-reliability-framing], which is also in that tier, so it is cut too. THE TWO READINGS COINCIDE AGAIN AT CYCLE 135, FOR THE THIRD RECORDED TIME AFTER CYCLES 124 AND 133. WHERE THEY DIVERGE, STATED PRECISELY SO A SUCCESSOR CAN RECOGNISE THE CASE WHEN IT ARRIVES: they diverge for any issue whose depends_on is NON-EMPTY BUT NONE OF WHOSE DEPENDENCIES SIT IN THE SAME SCORE TIER. Under the strict reading such an issue is excluded; under the pairwise reading it is MAXIMAL IN ITS TIER AND FULLY ELIGIBLE. No issue is in that position today -- but it needs only one dependency to move a score tier for one to be, and THE SCORE VECTOR IN THIS BASE HAS NOT MOVED SINCE CYCLE 118, which is exactly the condition under which a latent divergence goes unnoticed for a long time. WHAT THIS DOES NOT FIX, AND IT IS THE HONEST PART. THE PAIRWISE READING DOES NOT RESOLVE STEP (6)(ii) AND MUST NOT BE REPORTED AS RESOLVING IT. Cycles 130 through 134 have all recorded that rung 3(a) makes task-dependent-reliability-framing and extraction-vs-reasoning-ordinal-axis unreachable, and that between them those two carry ctr-0009 step (iii) -- src-0006's unfetched per-task scoring definitions, which six separate cycles now call the highest-value unfetched item in the whole base. UNDER THE PAIRWISE READING THOSE TWO ISSUES REMAIN UNREACHABLE WHENEVER THEIR DEPENDENCIES SHARE THEIR SCORE TIER, WHICH IS THE ACTUAL AND PERSISTENT SITUATION. The pairwise reading narrows the defect from 'permanent and structural' to 'contingent on the score vector'. THAT IS A REAL NARROWING AND A SMALL ONE. STEP (6)(ii) REMAINS A HUMAN'S AND IS UNCHANGED, AS DOES THE UNTERMINATED-TIE-BREAK-LIST DEFECT RAISED BY CYCLES 127, 130, 132, 133 AND 134. NO SCORE MOVES ON ACCOUNT OF THIS DISCHARGE.

TRA allows human experts to iteratively provide feedback for continuous improvement.' A workflow that incorporates human expert knowledge and iterative expert feedback IS NOT a workflow with no human validation loop, so (A)'s SECOND LIMB IS FALSE ABOUT src-0007 AT THE WORKFLOW LEVEL. WHY THIS IS NOT ctr-0066 AND IS NOT FOLDED INTO IT. ctr-0066 charges that the limb is OVER-DRAWN AS A CONTRAST -- that it implies, by opposition, that src-0003's measured system contained a human loop. THAT charge is about the src-0003 SIDE and is discharged by ctr-0066 step (i). So the honest statement DISTINGUISHES THE MEASURED CONFIGURATION FROM THE WORKFLOW AROUND IT. That distinction is EXACTLY the one ctr-0066 draws on the src-0003 side, which means THIS BASE HAS NOW MADE THE SAME CATEGORY ERROR TWICE, IN OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS, IN ADJACENT CANDIDATES OF THE SAME ISSUE. THE ENTRY EXISTS SO THAT PATTERN IS VISIBLE TO A SUCCESSOR AND TO A HUMAN. WHAT IS NOT CHARGED: the NO-REGEX limb (correct, load-bearing, untouched); candidate_resolutions[1]'s CONCLUSION that a second independent measurement of LLM IoC extraction exists (untouched and unaffected); src-0007's NUMBERS (untouched -- every standing src-0007 ban, including the whole of ctr-0037 and ctr-0038, applies unchanged and nothing here licenses a new figure); and ANY SCORE -- A T3 DOES NOT SCORE AND NONE IS PROPOSED.
